Description
Bullion Trading LLC introduces the10 oz Gold Bar from the secondary market, a popular avenue for investing in gold bullion bars. Investing in secondary market gold bars is the best way to acquire pure gold bars in larger quantities and at a premium lower than the spot price.
The 10 oz Gold (.9999 fine) gold bars are available at lower premiums and come in varying conditions, such as perfect, beautiful, or scruffy. Each 10 oz gold bar is carefully tested for its gold content and purity to ensure its authenticity and value.
Note:
Secondary Market bullion is pre-owned and not received directly from the manufacturer. The pieces might bear some tarnish, wear, or damage as they were owned previously.
